description:
## Question

Which shells get buck2 moves from 'the shell's toolchain.toml declares buck2' to a per-shell setting in flake.nix next to `turnkey.toolchains.declarationFiles`. What exactly is that setting: its name, type and default (on for every shell? only default?), how it interacts with the global `turnkey.buck2.enable`, and where `turnkey.buck2.version` (read-only) sits? Settle the interface, including what a consumer with a single shell writes.
title: What is the shape of the per-shell buck2 option?
